NEW.FAQ_INTRO: Here are the most frequently asked questions about Postier
NEW.WHAT_IS_POSTIER_CONTENT: The Postier application is designed to facilitate the timely pickup and delivery of parcels. Both users and  Postiers, can easily create and manage their parcels and trips within the app. Users can request a parcel pickup or delivery by providing the necessary details, such as the parcel's destination and size. On the other hand, Postiers can browse available trips and accept requests from users. One of the key features of the app is the bidding system, which allows users and Postiers to negotiate the price for services. Users can submit their budget for parcel delivery, while Postiers can offer their bids based on various factors, including distance and urgency. This dynamic bidding process ensures competitive pricing and allows users to find the best deals for their delivery needs. Overall, the Postier application aims to create a seamless and efficient experience for both users and postiers in the realm of parcel delivery.
NEW.BECOME_POSTIER: How can I be an Postier?
NEW.BECOME_POSTIER_CONTENT: To change the website to a parcel delivery service, simply navigate to the appropriate section and create a trip. You will have the option to switch to a postal service as well.
NEW.VIEW_EARNINGS: How Can I View My Earnings?
NEW.VIEW_EARNINGS_CONTENT: Please take a moment to review your earnings in the traction section of the dashboard.
NEW.SWITCH_ROLE: How to switch from Postier to Customer?
NEW.SWITCH_ROLE_CONTENT: Simply update the website to send parcels, and you can modify it to cater specifically to customers.

NEW.HOW_DO_SEND_PARCEL: How do I send a parcel?
NEW.HOW_DO_SEND_PARCEL_CONTENT: Unlock the convenience of our services by visiting our website or app to create your account today! Once you're logged in, effortlessly create a parcel by simply filling out the required fields. Experience seamless shipping like never before!
NEW.CAN_I_TRACK: Can I track my parcel after sending it
NEW.CAN_I_TRACK_CONTENT: Absolutely! Once you complete the payment for your order, the postier will pick up your parcel. After the pickup is confirmed, you will receive tracking information that will allow you to monitor the status of your shipment in real-time until it reaches its destination.
NEW.WHAT_ARE_PROHIBITED: What items are prohibited for shipping?
NEW.WHAT_ARE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT: Prohibited items include, but are not limited to: hazardous materials (e.g., explosives, flammable liquids), perishable goods (without proper packaging), animals, illegal substances, and currency or valuable items such as gold.
NEW.PICKUP_TIME_SCHEDULE: Can I schedule a specific pickup time for my parcel?
NEW.PICKUP_TIME_SCHEDULE_CONTENT: Yes, you can schedule a pickup at your convenience when creating a parcel. Enter your preferred date and time, and our postier will collect your parcel.
NEW.PACKAGING_USERFOR: What packaging should I use for my parcel?
NEW.PACKAGING_USERFOR_CONTENT: Use strong and appropriately sized packaging to protect your item during transit. Securely seal the package and add cushioning materials for fragile items.
